.. py:function:: make_matter_treemap(data, name, level=0)

   Makes a treemap of the matter in the model.
   Uses the plotly package to make a treemap of the matter composition at all levels in the model.

   :param data: A dictionary of the matter composition at all levels in the model.
   :type data: dict
   :param name: The name of the model.
   :type name: str
   :param level: The level of nesting to display.
   :type level: int

   :returns: None


.. py:function:: make_flowchart(model_object)

   Creates a flowchart for a model or a process object.
   Depending on the type of object, the appropriate function is called.
   Args:
   object (object): The object to create the flowchart of.
   Outputs:
   A flowchart of the object in the figures folder. Formats: SVG, PDF, PNG and DOT.



.. py:function:: make_network(model)

   This is a wrapper function that calls either make_network_process or make_network_matter depending on the type of object.
